derived_from.concurrency_section_10: The rows of the table of reference steps, split by the case of section 5 to 7 each step takes, as the step record can tell them apart (its rule, site, events, the control after it and whether its task is still Runnable). Steps of the handler machine taken by a task (EFFECTS.md, TC0-A) are not keys of this catalog: they are counted as inherited and measured by the handler and TC0-A catalogs.

depth: The depth of a step record counts the task's frames after it, scope frames included (section 10). depth_change is the difference from the same task's previous record; a task's first record (TaskStart) has no previous one.
invariants: After every step, for every channel: the queue holds at most its capacity; if a sender waits the queue is full; if a receiver waits the queue is empty (section 4).
A record's runnable list is the Runnable tasks in ID order, and a scheduling point is exactly the steps this catalog marks so (section 8).
